backup.customerSubtitle: Download an SQL file with your purchases and orders, or restore your personal history
backup.staffSubtitle: Manage SQL backups and restore the Huellitas Shop database
backup.downloadCustomerSubtitle: Exclusive export of your purchases and orders in .sql format
backup.downloadStaffSubtitle: Export in structured file with .sql format
backup.downloadCustomerBody: Generates a downloadable SQL file with the record of all your orders and purchased items. The backup contains exclusively your personal transactions, ensuring total privacy.
backup.downloadStaffBody: Generates a full dump of all system tables, records, and sequences. The resulting file is a standard SQL script compatible with PostgreSQL, suitable for direct restore or auditing.
backup.includesCustomer: Includes: Exclusively your orders and purchased items.
backup.includesStaff: Includes: Tables, data, pre-cleanup, and indexes/sequences.
backup.privacyCustomer: Privacy: Isolated, without access to other customers' purchases.
backup.encodingStaff: Encoding: UTF-8 with atomic transactional statements.
backup.restoreCustomerSubtitle: Restore your purchase history from an .sql file
backup.restoreStaffSubtitle: Import and restore data from an .sql file
backup.restoreCustomerBody: Upload a backup file with .sql extension to restore your purchase history in your Huellitas Shop account.
backup.restoreStaffBody: Upload a backup file with .sql extension to restore the database state. The operation executes in a fault-protected transaction.
backup.dragDropText: Drag and drop your .sql file here or click to select
backup.attentionCustomer: The restore will update your orders with the SQL file data. Other customers' records will not be affected.
backup.attentionStaff: The restore will replace current database data with the records from the SQL file. This action cannot be undone.
backup.confirmCustomerPrompt: You are about to restore your orders with the file:
backup.confirmStaffPrompt: You are about to restore the database with the file:
backup.confirmCustomerDesc: Your orders and purchases will be reset with the data from this personal copy.
backup.confirmStaffDesc: Current records will be cleaned and inserted with the data from this copy.
backup.reloginNotice: To synchronize active sessions and ensure all data displays updated, your current session will be closed.
backup.downloadError: An error occurred while generating the backup.
backup.restoreError: Error executing restore. The database was rolled back to its previous state.
